population.source_label: Ogle et al., Diabetes Res Clin Pract 2025 (IDF Atlas 11th ed. / T1D Index v3) — PMID 40412624

t1d_share_cgm.note: Share of CGM revenue from T1D users. T2D and OTC growth push this down over time.

t1d_share_pump.note: Pumps are overwhelmingly T1D; T2D AID labels are recent.

t1d_share_insulin.note: T1D is ~5–10% of diabetes patients but uses insulin on 100% of days; T2D still dominates volume.

residual_cgm_use.note: Cured patients may keep periodic CGM monitoring (graft surveillance).

initial_eligible_us.note: Vertex's stated initial zimislecel population (severe hypoglycemia) ≈60k.

bear.label: Bear: late and niche
bear.thesis: Immune-evasive cells slip, manufacturing stays scarce, and payers restrict access.

base.label: Base: immune-evasive cells work
base.thesis: A no-immunosuppression product is approved early next decade and adoption is capacity-limited.

bull.label: Bull: fast, broad adoption
bull.thesis: Fast approval, scaled manufacturing, and broad patient willingness.

immuno.label: Immunosuppression required
immuno.thesis: Only today's approach reaches market: cells plus lifelong immunosuppression, for the sickest patients.
